turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hello there! How's your day treating you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm going back to college at fifty-five and I haven't written an essay in thirty years.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's exciting. The basics haven't changed much. Have a clear argument, back it up, and keep each paragraph to one idea.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: What about all the referencing? That's what scares me.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Most colleges use one standard style and have a guide online. A free reference manager can format everything for you.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: So I don't have to type it all by hand?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Not at all. You save the sources as you read, and it builds the list at the end.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Well that's a relief. I was picturing

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Things have gotten a lot easier. Your library will likely run a short workshop on it too, worth asking.
